title: peucedanum triternatum
intro: Peucedanum triternatum, commonly known as Chinese angelica or Qiang Huo, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Peucedanum triternatum include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce fever, and improve respiratory function. Its bioactive constituents include coumarins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
